row: Discover discovery and career exploration at its best! Listen to career discussions and interviews with people doing real jobs and find out what it's really like in the day in the life of various occupations. Through different interviews, learn about the jobs of different professionals.  Find out how to choose a career and whether it makes sense for you to go to college or jump right into a career. This career and job resource is the ultimate guide for anyone exiting high school and trying to find the right job. Are you already established in your career and concerned about how to make money by leveraging skills which you already have? If you are wondering how you can change careers in your 30s, 40s, or 50s, I've spoken with professionals who talk about changing career paths successfully. The career change tips provided by over 125 professionals (and growing) is the perfect career advice that you need.
